title: Lords of the Fallen II now targets April 2027 🗡️
subject: lordsofthefallen2
description:
Is April 2027 worth the wait? 👇

CI Games CEO Marek Tymiński posted on November 24 that Lords of the Fallen II is coming in April 2027, with the exact date to be revealed in December. Hexworks' sequel was first planned for fall 2026 before being pushed into 2027 this summer.

Sources: Marek Tymiński on X (Nov 24, 2026), Push Square (Nov 24, 2026)
